The homemade food is also really good, and you can tell it’s made with care. There are also some adorable pets around the shop, which makes the experience even more fun and unique. 🐾🐦‍⬛🐈‍⬛

Overall, I really enjoyed the atmosphere, the people, the food, the drinks, and the whole vibe of the place. Definitely a spot I’d happily come back to and recommend to others! 💚✨

I originally came in looking for the Thai sticks Thailand is known for, and from the moment we walked into the shop, Mr. Stoney made us feel welcomed. He was incredibly friendly, knowledgeable, and passionate about both the product and the culture behind it.

As someone from Oregon who’s experienced with high-quality cannabis, I was genuinely impressed. The variety he had available was astounding. Everything was extremely aromatic, the buds were dense and clearly well cared for, and you could immediately see the passion and dedication from the growers behind it.

After purchasing a Thai stick pre-roll, we stayed and spent time talking with Mr. Stoney, his colleagues, and friends. They treated us like family. I was later offered the opportunity to try one of Stoney’s personal selections, and honestly, it became one of the most profound and spiritual experiences I’ve ever had. I felt deeply connected to the universe and even reflected on my late father-in-law in a way that was genuinely healing.

Throughout the experience, Mr. Stoney and everyone there looked after both me and my wife with kindness, hospitality, and care. It went far beyond just being a cannabis shop. It felt authentic, personal, and rooted in real culture and community.

Hands down, some of the best people and growers I’ve ever met. Mr. Stoney feels like a modern-day legend keeping the tradition and spirit alive that many of us only ever heard about or read about years ago.

Highly recommend visiting. Highly recommend getting to know the people behind it.
